detail.title: CP-UNC-BE21C-VMDS-Q
detail.overview: 2MP Full HD WDR Network Box Camera
features: Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264B, H.264H, MJPEG
WDR(120dB), Day/Night (ICR) , 3D NR, Defog, ROI, EIS, AWB, AGC, BLC, HLC
Support Micro SD Card, Built-in Mic, PoE

General.Minimum Illumination: Colour Mode 0.0021 Lux @F1.6, Night Mode (Black & White) 0.00021Lux @F1.6
General.White Balance: Auto, Natural, Street Lamp, Outdoor, Manual, Custom area
General.Video Compression: Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264B, H.264H, MJPEG (only supported by sub stream)
General.Bit Rate: H.265: 3 kbps–8192 kbps, H.264: 3 kbps–8192 kbps
General.Alarm IN: 2 Channels in: Wet contact, 5 mA 3–5 VDC
General.Alarm Out: 2 Channels out: Dry contact, 1,000 mA 30 VDC/500 mA 50 VAC
General.Overlay: Privacy Masking, Channel Title, Time Title, Location, Custom Title, Face Statistics
General.Protocol: IPv4, IPv6, HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, UDP, RTP, RTSP, RTCP, RTMP, SMTP V3, SFTP, DHCP, DNS, DDNS,  QoS, UPnP, NTP, Multicast, ICMP, IGMP, NAS, PPPoE, SNMP, Auto Connect, TLS v1.2 and v1.3,  ONVIF (Profile S, Profile G, Profile T)
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Intrusion, Tripwire, Abandon Object, Crowd gathering, Missing Object, Loitering Detection,  IMD (support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human); loitering  detection
General.People Counting: Tripwire people counting, generating and exporting report (day/week/month/year), People  counting in area and queue management, generating and exporting report (day/week/ month), 4 rules can be set for tripwire, People counting in area and queue management.
General.Face Detection: Face detection, Target Box Overlay,  Remove Duplicate, Face Cutout(Face/ One Inch Photo/  Custom) , Snapshot Mode(Real- Time/ Optimized/ Quality Priority), Optimal face snapshot  upload; face attributes extraction including 6 attributes and 8 expressions; snapshot strategies  (real-time snapshot, quality priority and optimization snapshot); face angle filter; Optimized  Duration, Quality Threshold, Snapshot Sensitivity
General.Event Alarm: No SD card, SD card full, SD card error, Network disconnection, IP conflict, Motion detection,  video tampering, Tripwire, Intrusion, Abandoned object, Missing object, Loitering detection,  Crowd gathering, Scene changing, Audio detection, Voltage detection, External alarm, Face  detection, IMD, People counting in area, Stay detection, People counting, Abnormal Number  of People, Queue people number alarm, Queue time alarm, Security exception, Defocus  detection
General.Cyber Security: AES 256-bit Encryption, Configuration encryption, trusted execution, Digest, Security logs,  WSSE, Account lockout, Syslog, Video encryption, 802.1x, Allow list/Block list, HTTPS,  Trusted upgrade, Trusted boot, Firmware encryption
General.Storage: SFTP, NAS, Micro SD card (support max. 512  GB)
General.Certificates: MTBF Certificate from STQC, ISO9001, CE, FCC and RoHS, BIS, STQC approved compliance  report
General.Power Out: 12 VDC power output, max. current 165 mA,  peak current 700 mA
